name: react-global-state-hooks
description: Monorepo for the react-global-state-hooks family of packages (universal, web, react-native).

scriptsInfo.format: Prettier write plus eslint --fix. Usage: yarn format [project]. Without a project it runs on every project that defines it (universal, web, mobile).
scriptsInfo.dev: Start a dev server. Usage: yarn dev <devtools|playground|website>. Without a project it starts all three.
scriptsInfo.test: Type-check the tests, then run Vitest once. Usage: yarn test [project] [vitest flags], e.g. --reporter=verbose. Without a project it runs on every project.
scriptsInfo.test:quick: Run Vitest once without type-checking the tests first. Usage: yarn test:quick [universal|web|mobile] [vitest flags].
scriptsInfo.test:debug: Vitest in watch mode with --inspect-brk --no-file-parallelism, waits for a debugger to attach. Usage: yarn test:debug <universal|web|mobile>.
scriptsInfo.test:debug:no-watch: Same as test:debug but a single run that exits when done. Usage: yarn test:debug:no-watch <universal|web|mobile>.
scriptsInfo.test:coverage: Run Vitest with coverage. Usage: yarn test:coverage [project] [html]. 'html' opens the report: the project's own, or one merged across the monorepo when no project is given.
scriptsInfo.test:interop: Packaging regression test: build, pack dist, install it in a throwaway project and import the subpaths under tsx, Node CJS and Node ESM. Usage: yarn test:interop [universal|web].
scriptsInfo.build: Type-check, clean, compile and bundle into dist/. Usage: yarn build [project]. Without a project it builds every project.
scriptsInfo.lint:fix: ESLint with --fix and --max-warnings=0. Usage: yarn lint:fix [project].
scriptsInfo.clean: Remove build output (dist, coverage). Usage: yarn clean [project].
scriptsInfo.ts-check: tsc --noEmit over the sources. Usage: yarn ts-check [project].
scriptsInfo.ts-check:tests: tsc --noEmit over the test files. Usage: yarn ts-check:tests [universal|web|mobile|monkey_patch].
scriptsInfo.publish:pkg: Upload the already built packages to npm in dependency order. No lint, test or build: run yarn prepare-packages first. Usage: yarn publish:pkg [package...] [otp] [--dry-run] [--plan]. code-review is published only when named.
scriptsInfo.publish:beta: Same as publish:pkg but to the beta tag. Every version must look like x.y.z-beta.N. Usage: yarn publish:beta [package...] [otp] [--dry-run] [--plan].
scriptsInfo.publish:one: Run a single project's own publish:pkg target through Nx. Usage: yarn publish:one <project>. Set NPM_OTP to pass the one-time password.
scriptsInfo.publish:one:beta: Run a single project's own publish:beta target through Nx. Usage: yarn publish:one:beta <project>. Set NPM_OTP to pass the one-time password.
scriptsInfo.prepare-packages: Pre-publish gate: lint, test and build each package. Usage: yarn prepare-packages [project]. Without a project it validates every package.
scriptsInfo.tarball: Build the publishable libs and npm pack each one into artifacts/, printing the file list npm would upload. Usage: yarn tarball [lib...].
scriptsInfo.version-bump: Bump versions. Sync-all: yarn version-bump <releaseType|version> sets the root and every workspace package to the same version. Targeted: yarn version-bump <package> [releaseType] bumps one package and cascades to its dependents (default minor). Add --dry-run to preview.
scriptsInfo.version:check: Compare local versions against the latest and beta dist-tags on npm (in-sync, ahead, behind, unpub). Usage: yarn version:check [--json]. Needs network access.
scriptsInfo.coverage: Run each lib's Vitest suite with coverage and print one combined table with a weighted total. Usage: yarn coverage [project...].
scriptsInfo.review: Run the code-review CLI (libs/code-review): coverage improvements and code reviews with coding agents. Usage: yarn review --help.
scriptsInfo.rgsh: Run the rgsh CLI from source: stream store actions from the DevTools panel, read a store, run an action or change state. Usage: yarn rgsh --help.
scriptsInfo.graph: Open the Nx project dependency graph in the browser.
scriptsInfo.preview:dev: Vite dev server with HMR for the DevTools local mock page. Usage: yarn preview:dev [devtools|todolist]. Default: devtools.

author: Johnny Quesada
